parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description: SAP HANA数据库的SID。SID必须与HANA实例匹配，且只能以字母开头，长度为3个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何查找SID](https://answers.sap.com/questions/555192/how-to-find-sid-user-and-instance-number-of-hana-d.html?)。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr delete-hana-instance --vault-id v-0008n2000000ax3 --cluster-id cl-000g4z090000009cfc --sid HXE --resource-group-id rg-acfmwutpyat2kwy --region cn-hangzhou
